units.summary: True statements: Choose four statements below which are true.
units.difficulty_basis: 4 marks, choose true statements from both sources (AO1)

units.summary: Summary: The writers in Source A and Source B are travelling on different types of trains. Use details from both sources to write a summary of what you understand about the differ
units.difficulty_basis: 8 marks, write a summary of differences or similarities drawing on both sources (AO1)

units.summary: Language: How does the writer use language to describe the train crash?
units.difficulty_basis: 12 marks, analyse how a writer uses language (AO2)

units.summary: Comparison: Compare how the writers convey their different feelings and perspectives about their experiences of travelling on a train.
units.difficulty_basis: 16 marks, compare the writers' viewpoints and the methods used across both sources (AO3)

units.summary: Viewpoint writing: Write a speech to be given at a meeting of your local council in which you argue your point of view on this statement.
units.difficulty_basis: 40 marks, extended writing presenting a viewpoint (24 content and organisation, 16 technical accuracy; AO5, AO6)
